Oriented: AGENT.md, head (written at D6a-15), the stage file, the last five diary lines, validate.py --open D6 (1 error: the template name forms/<id>-account.md, as at every leg); no .pause. D6a-16 the room selection rule for form F, stated before any room is read, under J's ruling of 12:25 (freedom to portray what is representative; nearness to the centre not required). What I find representative of F is its course, which its name and gloss state as three acts (room-forms-names.md): rooms ask for space before they build, move when the spot is lost, taken or claimed more than for too few hands, and build again at the new spot. Each act has a changed cell of F with its deciding op (fractal-forms-D6.jsonl): asking first, a restrict line on A04, P19 or P27; moving for the spot, a restrict line on A10; building again, a link line on P03. Rule: a defining room of F holds an act where one of its selected change lines (role defining, by _analysis/d6a11_form_telling.py --facts over all 34 defining rooms; d5a41 lines) has that unit and op. The three rooms are one holder per act, three different rooms, chosen as the triple that (1) has the most selected changes in sum (rich), then (2) shows the most of F's 14 changed cells together (the triple portrays the form jointly), then (3) has the most coded concepts in sum. Nearness to F's centre is not required; each room's distance to F's centre, its rank among the 34 and its nearest centre are reported. If an act has no holder, the triple is drawn from the acts that have one and the log says so. No room's record or A1 telling is read before the three are chosen; the selection is by script (_analysis/d6a16_select_F.py).

D6a-16 three rooms of form F chosen by the logged rule (_analysis/d6a16_select_F.py; d6a16_select_F.json): 34 defining rooms; holders by act: asking first 21, moving for the spot 16, building again 12; no act without a holder; the form's defining median is 11 selected changes (median distance 0.8811). The triple: asking first, r/sips (distance 0.7577, rank 2 of 34, nearest centre F, 21 selected changes, 109 coded concepts; holds that act only; shows A12, A06, P19, A04); moving for the spot, r/planetside (0.8658, rank 15, F, 20 changes, 134 concepts; holds that act only; shows P05, A10, K01, P12); building again, r/nbaspurs (0.853, rank 12, F, 21 changes, 243 concepts; holds all three acts; shows 9 of F's 14 cells). Together 62 selected changes and 11 of F's 14 changed cells (not shown by any of the three: P01, P14, P27).
